 At the WTA event in Tokyo, it's a case of Belarus vs Russia on Wednesday, when Aliaksandra Sasnovich has the tough task of taking on Diana Shnaider, who has been in decent form of late. The Belarusian has come through qualifying in decent style, but she now has her hardest task for a while, so let's not be surprised if the much higher-ranked player pulls clear without needing a third set. 
 Those looking for something nice and simple ahead of Wednesday's early morning action in the Japanese capital should look no further than a bet of 'Diana Shnaider to Win 2-0'. The higher-ranked player has shown more than enough in recent times to suggest that she can make it three straight-set wins from three matches against her opponent, who is not used to causing upsets in matches of this nature.

 Our Aliaksandra Sasnovich vs Diana Shnaider Prediction
 There's very little to suggest that Aliaksandra Sasnovich can come anywhere near seriously upsetting Diana Shnaider, who has been playing well of late.
